entries.zh: 空想；徒生无益的念头（「空思」指空费心思）
entries.en: to muse idly; to think vain, idle thoughts

entries.zh: 仔细盘算、反复筹划（「计计」：思量所当行之事）
entries.en: to reckon carefully; to plan out what is to be done
entries.notes: 西语释文跨行截断（「loq se ha-…」），末意赖「计计」补足。

entries.zh: 计较、反复比量（「较较」）
entries.en: to compare and weigh over and over; to reckon
entries.notes: 西语为跨行残句（「…ra para con sepillo」），所指难定，仅据汉字「较较」出义。

entries.zh: 悬想、苦思（用心着力地思量）
entries.en: to ponder with great care; to dwell on in thought

entries.zh: 揆度、揣度（估量思忖）
entries.en: to conjecture; to estimate and consider
entries.notes: 首字调符污损（T99），字形与西语「pensar」尚可相合。

entries.zh: 独自心想；暗自思量
entries.en: to think to oneself; to commune with oneself

entries.zh: 心想、思量
entries.en: to think; to reflect

entries.zh: 机心、巧诈之念（存心算计）
entries.en: a scheming mind; to think craftily
entries.notes: 「机心」为名词性，西语仅作「pensar」，词性略有不合；首字调符污损。

entries.zh: 心思、思虑（心中所念）
entries.en: thoughts; mental deliberation

entries.zh: 动恶念、起邪念（汉字作「起怯意」，兼含畏怯之意）
entries.en: to conceive evil thoughts; to think ill
entries.notes: 「起怯意」偏指畏怯，与西语「想坏事」不尽合；首字调符污损（T99）。

entries.zh: 点检、审度（思量某事是否合宜可行）
entries.en: to examine and weigh whether something is fitting
entries.notes: 「点检」本为查核、检点，此处引申为审度可否。

entries.zh: 反复思量、翻来覆去地想（「三翻五覆」）
entries.en: to turn something over and over in the mind; to ponder repeatedly

entries.zh: 三思、反复思考
entries.en: to think thrice; to deliberate carefully

entries.zh: 想起来、忆及
entries.en: to call to mind; to recall
entries.notes: 末字形态可疑（来／末）；西语「p̄」为 para 之缩写，全句读作「思之使忆起」。

entries.zh: 自思、暗自揣想
entries.en: to think to oneself; to conjecture
entries.notes: 西语作「揣想」，汉字「自思」偏于自省，义有出入。

entries.zh: 迂拙（思虑迂阔笨拙，想不出得当办法）
entries.en: to think ineptly; clumsy and wide of the mark in one's thinking
entries.notes: 「迂拙」本为形容人之迂阔笨拙，西语作「思而无当」；首字调符污损（T99）。

entries.zh: 思忆、思念（想着而盼望）
entries.en: to think of with longing; to muse desirously

entries.zh: 忆着、念念不忘（记挂于心）
entries.en: to keep thinking of; to remember longingly
entries.notes: 「忆着」为记挂、念着之常语，西语「deseando」略偏「盼望」，义可通而侧重不同。

entries.zh: 原情（推原情由、体谅宽宥）
entries.en: to excuse; to make allowance for the circumstances
entries.notes: 西语残句「pensar,san fear」不成词，与「原情」无从相证，仅据汉字出义，存疑。

entries.zh: 耽忧、忧思（沉思而心神不属）
entries.en: pensive and abstracted; sunk in anxious thought
entries.notes: 首字疑为「耽」或「舵」；西语为形容词，汉字为动宾结构，义可通而词性不合。

entries.zh: 耽于烦恼、愁思不展
entries.en: steeped in worries; pensively troubled
entries.notes: 首字存疑（耽／舵）；西语与上条重复，汉字加重为「烦恼」。
